participant_roles: API Gateway (hospital-gateway), Service Registry (EurekaServer), Auth Service (auth-service), Patient Service (patient-service), Appointment Service (appointment-service)
intent_and_evidence: Decouples hospital domain services into independently deployable microservices behind API Gateway and Eureka discovery server.
Central entry point that routes /auth/**, /api/patients/**, /api/appointments/** and inspects JWT tokens before forwarding.
Dynamic discovery allowing services to locate each other via lb:// identifiers without hardcoded IP/port mappings.
Separates HTTP handling, persistence abstractions, and domain entities into distinct packages.

participant_roles: Repository Interface (PatientRepo, AppointmentRepo, UserRepo), Entity (Patient, Appointment, User), Spring Data JPA Framework
intent_and_evidence: Encapsulates database CRUD operations and query execution behind interface abstractions extending JpaRepository.

instance_name: Spring Cloud Gateway Global Filter Chain
participant_roles: Filter Interface (GlobalFilter), Concrete Filter (JwtAuthenticationFilter), ServerWebExchange Context
intent_and_evidence: Passes incoming HTTP requests through a chain of filters to validate JWT tokens and inject X-User-Name header before downstream routing.

participant_roles: Strategy Interface (WebClient / RestTemplate), Context (AppointmentController), Concrete Execution (rest-template vs webclient endpoints)
intent_and_evidence: Encapsulates synchronous patient verification calls using interchangeable REST client mechanisms.
